items.title: NICE recommends maralixibat for treatment of cholestatic pruritus in Alagille Syndrome
items.summary: Liver UK is delighted to hear Friday’s announcement from the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) that they recommend maralixibat for use within the NHS for treating cholestatic pruritus (severe itch) due to Alagille syndrome in patients two months of age and older.

items.title: LiHAB: a liver rehabilitation practice model for health promotion in cirrhosis care
items.summary: Cirrhosis is a chronic and progressive liver disease that affects not only hepatic function but also physical wellbeing. Current hepatology care primarily focuses on its prevention and treatment of complications, while rehabilitation and health promotion remain underutilised component.
